Solrød is a Danish municipality tracked in the national clinical quality databases for healthcare benchmarking [^src1]. In the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, Solrød is listed among the 98 Danish municipalities evaluated for the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1]. Its data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is included in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant treatment [^src1]. The available data for Solrød in this report is limited to a single tabular entry showing the municipality did not meet the indicator target ("Nej"), alongside specific cohort sizes and statistical estimates [^src1].
